name: a forged multipart session is rejected
why: The session is the only thing tying a caller to an object. If a forged one were accepted, anyone could sign parts for — or abort — another user's upload.

name: a malformed multipart session is rejected the same way
why: One response for every failure mode, so probing reveals nothing about which part of the token was wrong.

name: aborting with a forged session is rejected
